ValidationRule.description: To close a case that is classified as "Monetary claim" or "Reclamación" must have the following fields completed: Classification, Reason, Client Name and Asset.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( !$Setup.CIB_Bypass__c.CIB_skip_validationrule__c, !$Setup.CIB_User_Org__c.CIB_Is_Admin__c, $Setup.CIB_User_Org__c.CIB_Is_Service__c, ISPICKVAL(SER_Business_Case_Type__c, "GM"), NOT(ISBLANK(SER_SLA_Service__c)), SER_Pre_liquidacion__c = TRUE , OR( ISBLANK(TEXT( SER_Subtype_GM__c )), ISBLANK(SER_Asset__c ), OR( ISBLANK(AccountId ) , AND(!ISBLANK(AccountId) , AccountId = $Label.SER_InternalContactAccountID) ) ), ISPICKVAL( SER_Classification__c, "Monetary claim"), OR( ISPICKVAL(Status,"Closed"), SER_Close__c = True ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: To close a case that is classified as "Monetary claim" must have the following fields completed: Classification, Reason, Client Name and Asset. Client Name can't be an Internal Contact Client.
